summary: Tested calculator share image, AI chat auto-handoff to tickets (player + agent), agent chat access and Support page, admin/staff Chat Insights, role guards and rate limit, and the manual ticket regression. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass, using about 6 LLM calls. Frontend: all requested flows work. One CRITICAL UI crash was found in ChatWidget and fixed (details below). The fix was checked by sending immediately after 'New chat' as the agent.

minor.issue: Text streamed before the [[TICKET]] tag keeps its trailing newlines, and then '\n\nSupport ticket ...' is added. The live bubble shows 3-4 blank lines before the ticket note. History is clean because the reply is rstripped there. Fix: hold back trailing whitespace while streaming, or lstrip the note.

LlmChat is built and system_prompt() runs DB aggregations BEFORE the 429 rate-limit check. Move the rate-limit check first. Also, user messages are only saved after the stream ends, so parallel requests can get past the limit.
When a ticket is reused, the LLM still says 'I'm opening a support ticket' even though no new ticket is made. Wording is slightly misleading but harmless.
STOP list is missing common filler words, so 'never', 'ago', 'got', 'many', 'days' rank among the top words. Test payment refs like 'upi888' also show up as words.
The transcript message's author_role/author_name is the player, so the bot-opened ticket shows as written by 'DEMO PLAYER'. The transcript also leaves out the bot's final reply. Cosmetic.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTING AGENT. Runtime crash 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading content)' when a message is sent before the /assistant/history request returns, e.g. right after clicking New chat or on first open. The late history response replaced msgs with [], and patch() then read m[-1].content. Fix: history effect uses a live flag and setMsgs(m => m.length ? m : r.data); patch guards an empty array.

issues: Sonner toast at bottom-right sits partly under the chat launcher button; the View action is partly covered. Consider toast position top-center or an offset.
Referral link in the image is cut at 67 chars, so on long domains (preview) the ?ref=CODE part is cut off. The code is shown in large text above, so this is minor.

action_items: Review the ChatWidget race-condition fix applied by the testing agent (/app/frontend/src/components/ChatWidget.jsx)
Trim whitespace before the ticket note in the SSE stream (extra blank lines)
Move the rate-limit check before building LlmChat/system_prompt
Optional: extend the insights STOP words; move the toast so it doesn't overlap the launcher
critical_code_review_comments: assistant.py events(): if the LLM writes '[[' without a valid tag, everything after it is silently dropped and no ticket is made. Acceptable, but consider logging it.
Rate-limit count only includes saved messages, so it can be bypassed by concurrent streams.
ChatWidget uses a localStorage session key shared across roles in the same browser. Data is safe because history/tickets filter by user_id, but the old session id is reused for the new user.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after fix (1 crash found and fixed)

Note: the tests create tickets, so clean them up by reference afterwards. Verified: share image 1080x1350 has no overlap; the wa.me popup opens with the referral text; toast View goes to /app/support; agent reply was '5%, 1 referred player', matching the dashboard; insights toggle sends days=7/90.
rca of the issue: ChatPanel useEffect([session]) fetched history and called setMsgs(r.data) without checking for stale results. If the user sends before the response arrives, msgs [user, assistant-placeholder] is replaced by []. The next stream delta runs patch(), which reads m[m.length-1].content on an empty array, throws, and React unmounts the panel. Reproduced by clicking New chat and sending immediately. Mitigated by a live flag plus not overwriting non-empty msgs, and by guarding patch().
